heading: Faisal Town Phase 2 Questions
faqsText:
Which Phase 2 sectors are cash only? | Sector O, Sector P, Sector Q and Sector R are currently cash-only Model Blocks. | yes
Which Phase 2 sectors are available on installments? | Sector S and Sector T are currently the installment options. Ask for the latest schedule for the exact available plot. | yes
What is the lowest listed lump-sum price? | Sector T 5.56 Marla has a lump-sum price of PKR 27.90 Lac; its 36-month installment total is PKR 34.95 Lac, subject to exact-plot availability and any applicable charges. | yes
Does Sector P use the same price plan as Sector T? | No. Sector P / The Caladan is a cash-only Model Block with its own separate premium price plan. | yes
Are Sector O, Q and R 5.56 Marla plots currently available? | Not in the active inventory shared with us. Their current starting inventory is 8 Marla and larger. | yes
Can I currently buy in Overseas/W/X? | We are not currently offering plots in Overseas, W or X. These areas appear on the master plan; ask us about available options in other sectors. | yes
Can I open official sector plans? | Yes. You can open the sector plans for O, P, Q, R, S and T, as well as the full Phase 2 master plan. | yes
How do I confirm current plot availability? | Use the WhatsApp enquiry buttons and mention the sector, payment preference, plot size and budget. Current availability should be checked before proceeding. | yes
